svg.title: Chih-Kai Wang — ckw whoami
svg.desc: A terminal session: the name drawn as a dot matrix, then a short profile. Chih-Kai Wang, Taipei; Python and TypeScript tools for inspectable AI and mathematical research.

g.text: Mathematics Division, Dept. of Mathematics and Information
Education, National Taipei University of Education ·
20 projects · 4 negative results kept · 3 merged upstream
Small Python and TypeScript tools that let
you check a claim yourself: the evidence
is attached, the limits are written down,
and the results that failed stay
Published agentconf-audit, a static security audit
of AI-agent configuration, and used it to tighten
my own Codex and Claude Code settings.
Released three works made entirely as code: ORACLE,
The Disease Called AI and world.execute(me).
